mechanism_narrative: A continued rebound in WORKPLACES mobility, combined with a still-elevated but easing TRANSIT shortfall, signals more routine commuting and discretionary stopovers. That mix should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as weekday trips reconnect to shopping corridors.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises or stays flat for the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week mean, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline but trends downward week to week, time spent at home is falling and more local errand and leisure trips should spill into retail venues. That should push RETAIL_REC upward within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls at least 0.5 points week-on-week after staying above baseline for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL declines under the trigger condition but RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next two weekly means, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A positive PARKS surprise relative to the prior week indicates better outdoor conditions or weekend activity substitution. In the next week, that should spill over into nearby retail and recreation visits, raising RETAIL_REC as outdoor foot traffic reconnects with shopping and dining trips.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to non-negative week-on-week
failure_condition: If PARKS moves from negative to non-negative but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the following weekly mean, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed while WORKPLACES continue improving, the commuting channel is still constrained by transport friction. In that case retail activity should stay subdued or weaken over four weeks because fewer trips convert into shopping visits.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -30 while WORKPLACES is above -13 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If the trigger holds but RETAIL_REC rises above its last four-week average within 28 days, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A broad pickup in grocery and pharmacy visits signals restored short-distance trip frequency and household out-of-home circulation. That routine mobility should continue to support RETAIL_REC modestly over the next two weeks because errands and shopping are complementary.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is stable or rising but RETAIL_REC falls over the next two weekly means, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS together with a continued decline in RESIDENTIAL indicates substitution away from staying home toward outside-the-home leisure. That combination should raise RETAIL_REC over four weeks as recreational outings and shopping trips reinforce each other.
failure_condition: If PARKS rises while RESIDENTIAL falls but RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the prior four-week mean, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains far below baseline and WORKPLACES do not recover enough to restore commuting density, retail demand should keep drifting down because fewer city-center trips generate incidental shopping. The effect should appear within four weeks and be strongest in the commuting-dependent segment.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -35 and WORKPLACES stays below -12 for four straight weeks
failure_condition: If the trigger persists but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A slow improvement in PARKS after a weak winter baseline indicates seasonal normalization in outdoor activity. That normalization should lift retail-and-recreation mobility over one week by increasing discretionary trip volume and weekend spillover into shops and cafes.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises for two consecutive weeks after being negative in the prior month
evidence_refs: fact:week ending 2020-09-15 shows PARKS moving from -11.1 to -0.9 across four weeks
failure_condition: If PARKS continues improving for two weeks but RETAIL_REC does not rise in the next weekly mean, the mechanism is rejected.
